001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import gnu.trove.iterator.TIntIntIterator;
004import gnu.trove.map.hash.TIntIntHashMap;
005import java.util.Arrays;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
012import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
013import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
014import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
015import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
016
017/**
018 *
019 * @author jimmy
020 */
021public class PropJoinFunctionCard extends Propagator<Variable> {
022
023    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
024
025    private final SetVar take;
026    private final IntVar takeCard;
027    private final IntVar[] refs;
028    private final IntVar toCard;
029    private final Integer globalCardinality;
030
031    public PropJoinFunctionCard(SetVar take, IntVar takeCard, IntVar[] refs, IntVar toCard, Integer globalCardinality) {
032        super(buildArray(take, takeCard, toCard, refs), PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, false);
033        this.take = take;
034        this.takeCard = takeCard;
035        this.refs = refs;
036        this.toCard = toCard;
037        this.globalCardinality = globalCardinality;
038    }
039
040    private static Variable[] buildArray(SetVar take, IntVar takeCard, IntVar toCard, IntVar[] refs) {
041        Variable[] array = new Variable[refs.length + 3];
042        array[0] = take;
043        array[1] = takeCard;
044        array[2] = toCard;
045        System.arraycopy(refs, 0, array, 3, refs.length);
046        return array;
047    }
048
049    private boolean isTakeVar(int idx) {
050        return idx == 0;
051    }
052
053    private boolean isTakeCardVar(int idx) {
054        return idx == 1;
055    }
056
057    private boolean isToCardVar(int idx) {
058        return idx == 2;
059    }
060
061    private boolean isRefVar(int idx) {
062        return idx >= 3;
063    }
064
065    private int getRefVarIndex(int idx) {
066        assert isRefVar(idx);
067        return idx - 3;
068    }
069
070    public boolean hasGlobalCardinality() {
071        return globalCardinality != null;
072    }
073
074    public int getGlobalCardinality() {
075        assert hasGlobalCardinality();
076        return globalCardinality.intValue();
077    }
078
079//    @Override
080//    public boolean advise(int idxVarInProp, int mask) {
081//        if (isRefVar(idxVarInProp)) {
082//            return take.getUB().contains(getRefVarIndex(idxVarInProp));
083//        }
084//        return super.advise(idxVarInProp, mask);

086    @Override
087    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
088        if (isTakeVar(vIdx)) {
089            return SetEventType.all();
090        }
091        if (isRefVar(vIdx)) {
092            return IntEventType.instantiation();
093        }
094        assert isTakeCardVar(vIdx) || isToCardVar(vIdx);
095        return IntEventType.boundAndInst();
096    }
097
098    private int countAdditionalSameRefsAllowed(TIntIntHashMap map) {
099        assert hasGlobalCardinality();
100        int gc = getGlobalCardinality();
101
102        int allowed = 0;
103
104        if (gc != 1) {
105            TIntIntIterator iter = map.iterator();
106            for (int i = map.size(); i-- > 0;) {
107                iter.advance();
108                assert iter.value() > 0;
109                assert iter.value() <= gc;
110                allowed += gc - iter.value();
111            }
112            assert !iter.hasNext();
113        }
114
115        return allowed;
116    }
117
118    private TIntIntHashMap countRefs() {
119        TIntIntHashMap map = new TIntIntHashMap(take.getLB().size());
120        ISetIterator iter = take.getLB().iterator();
121        while (iter.hasNext()) {
122            int i = iter.nextInt();
123            IntVar ref = refs[i];
124            if (ref.isInstantiated()) {
125                map.adjustOrPutValue(ref.getValue(), 1, 1);
126            }
127        }
128        return map;
129    }
130
131    private TIntIntHashMap constrainGlobalCardinality() throws ContradictionException {
132        assert hasGlobalCardinality();
133        int[] ker = PropUtil.iterateKer(take);
134        TIntIntHashMap map = new TIntIntHashMap(ker.length);
135        for (int i = 0; i < ker.length; i++) {
136            constrainGlobalCardinality(ker, i, i, map);
137        }
138        return map;
139    }
140
141    private void constrainGlobalCardinality(int[] ker, int index, int explored, TIntIntHashMap map) throws ContradictionException {
142        assert hasGlobalCardinality();
143        assert index <= explored;
144        assert explored < ker.length;
145
146        IntVar a = refs[ker[index]];
147        if (a.isInstantiated()) {
148            int value = a.getValue();
149            int count = map.adjustOrPutValue(value, 1, 1);
150            int gc = getGlobalCardinality();
151
152            if (count == gc) {
153                for (int j = 0; j < explored; j++) {
154                    IntVar b = refs[ker[j]];
155                    if (!b.isInstantiatedTo(value) && b.removeValue(value, this)) {
156                        constrainGlobalCardinality(ker, j, explored, map);
157                    }
158                }
159                for (int j = explored + 1; j < ker.length; j++) {
160                    refs[ker[j]].removeValue(value, this);
161                }
162            } else if (count > gc) {
163                fails();
164            }
165        }
166    }
167
168    private static int divRoundUp(int a, int b) {
169        assert a >= 0;
170        assert b > 0;
171
172        return (a + b - 1) / b;
173    }
174
175    @Override
176    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
177        takeCard.updateLowerBound(take.getLB().size(), this);
178        takeCard.updateUpperBound(take.getUB().size(), this);
179
180        ISetIterator takeEnv = take.getUB().iterator();
181        while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
182            int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
183            if (i < 0 || i >= refs.length) {
184                take.remove(i, this);
185            }
186        }
187
188        boolean changed;
189        do {
190            changed = false;
191            TIntIntHashMap map = hasGlobalCardinality() ? constrainGlobalCardinality() : countRefs();
192            int instCard = map.size();
193            int kerSize = take.getLB().size();
194
195            int minUninstantiated;
196            int maxUninstantiated;
197            int minCard;
198            int maxCard;
199            boolean cardChanged;
200            do {
201                cardChanged = false;
202                int kerUninstantiated = 0;
203                takeEnv.reset();
204                while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
205                    int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
206                    if (!refs[i].isInstantiated()) {
207                        if (take.getLB().contains(i)) {
208                            kerUninstantiated++;
209                        }
210                    }
211                }
212                assert takeCard.getLB() >= kerSize;
213                minUninstantiated = takeCard.getLB() - kerSize + kerUninstantiated;
214                maxUninstantiated = takeCard.getUB() - kerSize + kerUninstantiated;
215                minCard = instCard
216                        + (hasGlobalCardinality()
217                                ? divRoundUp(Math.max(0, minUninstantiated - countAdditionalSameRefsAllowed(map)), getGlobalCardinality())
218                                : 0);
219                maxCard = instCard + maxUninstantiated;
220
221                toCard.updateLowerBound(minCard, this);
222                toCard.updateUpperBound(maxCard, this);
223
224                if (hasGlobalCardinality()) {
225                    cardChanged |= takeCard.updateUpperBound(toCard.getUB() * getGlobalCardinality(), this);
226                }
227                cardChanged |= takeCard.updateLowerBound(toCard.getLB(), this);
228            } while (cardChanged);
229
230            if (maxUninstantiated != 0) {
231                if (instCard == toCard.getUB()) {
232                    // The rest must be duplicates.
233                    ISetIterator takeKer = take.getLB().iterator();
234                    while (takeKer.hasNext()) {
235                        int i = takeKer.nextInt();
236                        IntVar ref = refs[i];
237                        assert !ref.isInstantiated() || map.contains(ref.getValue());
238                        if (!ref.isInstantiated()) {
239                            changed |= PropUtil.domSubsetSet(ref, map.keySet(), this) && ref.isInstantiated();
240                        }
241                    }
242                }
243                if (maxCard == toCard.getLB()) {
244                    // No more duplicate values.
245                    ISetIterator takeKer = take.getLB().iterator();
246                    while (takeKer.hasNext()) {
247                        int i = takeKer.nextInt();
248                        IntVar ref = refs[i];
249                        if (!ref.isInstantiated()) {
250                            TIntIntIterator iter = map.iterator();
251                            for (int j = map.size(); j-- > 0;) {
252                                iter.advance();
253                                changed |= ref.removeValue(iter.key(), this) && ref.isInstantiated();
254                            }
255                            assert !iter.hasNext();
256                        }
257                    }
258                }
259            }
260        } while (changed);
261    }
262
263    @Override
264    public ESat isEntailed() {
265        TIntIntHashMap map = new TIntIntHashMap();
266        int gc = hasGlobalCardinality() ? getGlobalCardinality() : Integer.MAX_VALUE;
267        ISetIterator takeKer = take.getLB().iterator();
268        while (takeKer.hasNext()) {
269            int i = takeKer.nextInt();
270            if (i < 0 || i >= refs.length) {
271                return ESat.FALSE;
272            }
273            IntVar ref = refs[i];
274            if (ref.isInstantiated()) {
275                if (map.adjustOrPutValue(ref.getValue(), 1, 1) > gc) {
276                    return ESat.FALSE;
277                }
278            }
279        }
280
281        boolean completelyInstantiated = take.isInstantiated() && takeCard.isInstantiated() && toCard.isInstantiated();
282        int instCard = map.size();
283        int minUninstantiated = Math.max(0, takeCard.getLB() - take.getLB().size());
284        int maxUninstantiated = Math.max(0, takeCard.getUB() - take.getLB().size());
285        ISetIterator takeEnv = take.getUB().iterator();
286        while (takeEnv.hasNext()) {
287            int i = takeEnv.nextInt();
288            if (i >= 0 && i < refs.length && !refs[i].isInstantiated()) {
289                completelyInstantiated = false;
290                if (take.getLB().contains(i)) {
291                    minUninstantiated++;
292                }
293                maxUninstantiated++;
294            }
295        }
296        int minCard = instCard
297                + (hasGlobalCardinality()
298                        ? divRoundUp(Math.max(0, minUninstantiated - countAdditionalSameRefsAllowed(map)), getGlobalCardinality())
299                        : 0);
300        int maxCard = instCard + maxUninstantiated;
301
302        if (toCard.getUB() < minCard) {
303            return ESat.FALSE;
304        }
305        if (toCard.getLB() > maxCard) {
306            return ESat.FALSE;
307        }
308
309        return completelyInstantiated ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
310    }
311
312    @Override
313    public String toString() {
314        return "joinFunctionCard(" + take + ", " + takeCard + ", " + Arrays.toString(refs) + ", " + toCard + ", " + globalCardinality + ")";
315    }
316}
